edits.descriptionKo: 왼쪽 위의 밝은 수련이 분홍색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the pale lily flower near the upper-left edge at x3 y7 to rose pink, preserving Monet brushstrokes.

edits.descriptionKo: 위쪽 왼편의 작은 수련이 붉게 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the isolated pale horizontal lily blossom near x18 y5 to muted red, same loose painterly edges.

edits.descriptionKo: 왼쪽 중간의 연두색 수련 잎이 없어졌어요.
edits.instructionEn: Remove the isolated pale green oval lily pad near x22 y34 and fill with matching lavender pond reflections.

edits.descriptionKo: 왼쪽 꽃 무리의 오른쪽 꽃이 진분홍색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the pale peach lily blossom near x28 y41 to deep rose pink while retaining the same paint marks.

edits.descriptionKo: 왼쪽 아래 꽃 무리의 밝은 수련이 없어졌어요.
edits.instructionEn: Remove the small bright cream lily around x19 y54, restoring the green and purple water behind it.

edits.descriptionKo: 위쪽 가운데의 작은 노란 수련이 선명한 초록색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor only the small pale-yellow lily near the upper center inside this target to vivid emerald green. Preserve the exact horizontal brushstroke shape, loose painterly edges, location and surrounding water.

edits.descriptionKo: 위쪽 가운데 오른편 수련의 연초록 부분이 선명한 빨간색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor only the pale-green painted strokes of this upper-center-right green-white lily to vivid scarlet red. Preserve its white highlights as white, loose brushstroke shapes, exact placement and surrounding water.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 위 꽃 무리의 아래 꽃이 붉게 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the isolated pale cream flower below the upper-center-right lily group around x68 y29 to red, matching original brushwork.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 아래의 밝은 수련이 분홍색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the large pale white lily in the lower-right group around x85 y90 to bright pink, preserving its round painted form.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 끝 아래의 밝은 수련이 없어졌어요.
edits.instructionEn: Remove the pale oval lily at the far-right lower edge around x96 y88 and fill with the surrounding dark green pond brushstrokes.
